C's filter works: the shipped board went 1841 -> 941 and Tom Brady is gone. A DETECTOR THAT CAN ONLY BE TESTED WHILE THE DEFECT IS STILL PRESENT STOPS BEING TESTED THE DAY IT SUCCEEDS. This is the frozen input so it stays testable afterwards. Fields are trimmed to what the detectors read; the ids and names are verbatim.
Built by A and offered to C — the assertions are C's to re-point.
